ValidationRule.description: Validation rules to ensure Opportunity Forecast Category ‘Closed’ maps to Stages 5, 6 & 7 only and ‘Omitted’ maps to Lost Stage
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND ( OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName,'5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'6 - Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'7 - Closed') ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(ForecastCategoryName,'Closed')), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Lost'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(ForecastCategoryName,'Omitted')), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Moving to Stage 5/6/7 requires 'Closed' in Forecast Category. Moving to Stage Lost requires 'Omitted' in Forecast Category
